settings.editor: Sut Das Darel Festival is an amazing annual event conducted in Gilgit-Baltistan’s gorgeous Darel Valley. This dynamic nine-day festival celebrates the region’s rich history, traditions, and sports, providing visitors with a unique opportunity to participate in local activities such as polo, horse racing, football, and traditional music. The festival with its breathtaking natural scenery and deep dig into local heritage, is a must-see event for those looking for a memorable cultural experience.

This 8-10-day family tour to Darel Valley is designed for comfort, fun, and unforgettable moments. From scenic mountain drives and historic forts to the peaceful beauty of Gilgit district and lively local bazaars, each day offers something special for all ages. With smooth travel, cozy stays, and guided visits, this trip is the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation for your whole family.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_content:
On this Day

Arrive in Gilgit, the capital of Gilgit-Baltistan, via flight or car from Islamabad. Check into your lodging and unwind. In the evening, take a stroll through the local markets and sample traditional Gilgiti food.

On this Day

After breakfast, drive to Darel in the Diamer District, which takes around 4-5 hours through picturesque valleys and rivers. Check into your hotel and enjoy the village's natural beauty and peaceful environment before the festival begins.

On this Day

The festival formally opens with a big opening ceremony, which kicks off the week-long events. The first few days are full of traditional activities such as polo, where local riders compete fiercely in this classic activity, as well as football and volleyball matches, which allow you to interact with the community while also enjoying the local athletic ability. The nights are complemented by Bazm Adab, a cultural and poetic display including local poets and artists who provide a deep dive into the region's literary tradition. Every day provides a new surge of excitement, with exhilarating activities such as cricket, horse races, and tug-of-war tournaments. You can also visit the traditional craft stalls, where experienced artists sell their handcrafted items including embroidered fabrics, carpets, and jewelry. Throughout the festival, local dance and musical performances create a festive atmosphere and provide a glimpse into Darel's cultural life. You'll also have the opportunity to explore local historical sites, go on nature hikes, and experience the region's hospitality and traditional foods.

On this Day

Take a break from the celebration to explore Sut Das' pristine beauty. Take a nature walk or light trek, explore historical places, and mingle with the locals to learn about their customs.

On this Day

After an unforgettable adventure, return to Gilgit in the morning. Spend time touring or shopping before in gilgit.

On this Day

On this day the participants will take a flight from the airport in Gilgit to Islamabad airport. You will have a good time to relax at the hotel in Islamabad.
